nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the base token URI used by _baseURI and tokenURI.
Public uint256 mint price (0.25 ether) used to validate msg.value in mint.
Public uint256 hard cap of 777 tokens, checked in mint and used as modulus in setStartingIndex.
Public uint256 maximum tokens mintable per transaction.
Public uint256 maximum tokens a single whitelisted address may mint.
Public bool pause flag gating mint.
Public bool controlling metadata reveal and gating setName.
Public bool enabling the whitelist gate in mint.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) tracking per-address minted counts.
Public uint256 block number used as the blockhash source for provenance randomness.
Public uint256 provenance starting index derived from blockhash.
Private mapping(uint256=>string) storing the name of each token.
Private mapping(string=>bool) tracking names already claimed.
Public payable mint function with pause, amount, supply, whitelist and payment checks that mints NFTs via _safeMint.
Public view function looping over whitelistedAddresses to check membership.
Public view function returning the token ids owned by an address.
Public view override returning notRevealedUri or concatenated base URI, token id and extension.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock modulo maxSupply.
onlyOwner function that sets startingIndexBlock to current block.number.
Public function allowing a token owner to assign a validated, unused name to their token.
Public view function returning whether the lowercased name is already used.
Public pure function validating name length, characters and spacing.
Public pure function lowercasing an ASCII string.
onlyOwner function setting revealed to true.
onlyOwner function updating the mint cost.
onlyOwner function updating maxMintAmount.
onlyOwner function updating nftPerAddressLimit.
onlyOwner function updating baseURI.
onlyOwner function toggling the paused flag.
onlyOwner function toggling the onlyWhitelisted flag.
onlyOwner function replacing the whitelistedAddresses array.
onlyOwner payable function distributing contract balance via low-level calls to fixed addresses.
Caller address, attacker controllable, used for owner bypass, whitelist and balance accounting.
Low-level CALL with value performed in withdraw to three fixed payout addresses.
External onERC721Received callback invoked by _safeMint on the recipient contract during mint.
_mintAmount parameter of mint controlling loop iterations and payment multiplication.
supply local variable of mint holding totalSupply() before minting.
ownerMintedCount local variable of mint read from addressMintedBalance[msg.sender].
tokenId parameter of setName identifying the token to name.
name parameter of setName holding the requested token name.
str parameter of validateName containing the name bytes to validate.
str parameter of toLower containing the string to lowercase.
addressOneAmt local variable in withdraw computed as balance * 15 / 100.
addressTwoAmt local variable in withdraw computed as balance * 5 / 100.

edges.reason: mint reads the paused flag to gate minting.
mint multiplies cost by _mintAmount to validate the received msg.value.
mint adds supply and _mintAmount and compares the sum to maxSupply.
mint bounds _mintAmount using maxMintAmount.
mint enforces nftPerAddressLimit for non-owner callers.
mint branches on the onlyWhitelisted flag to require whitelist membership.
mint reads addressMintedBalance to enforce the per-address limit.
mint increments addressMintedBalance for every minted token.
mint reads startingIndexBlock to detect the reveal trigger condition.
mint writes startingIndexBlock when totalSupply reaches maxSupply.
mint uses msg.sender for the owner bypass and for whitelist/balance checks.
setName requires msg.sender to equal ownerOf(tokenId).
setStartingIndex derives the index from blockhash modulo maxSupply.
setStartingIndex consumes blockhash(startingIndexBlock), a miner-influenceable value.
setStartingIndex requires startingIndex to still be zero.
setStartingIndex writes a miner-influenced startingIndex value.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock from block.number.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to still be zero.
setName requires the revealed flag to be true.
tokenURI returns notRevealedUri while revealed is false.
setName reads the old and writes the new entry of _tokenNames.
setName clears and sets entries in _namesUsed.
isNameUsed reads the _namesUsed mapping.
mint calls _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received callback to the recipient.
withdraw transfers ETH through low-level calls to external addresses.
_mintAmount parameter drives the mint loop and the cost multiplication.
supply local derived from totalSupply is used for token ids in the mint loop.
ownerMintedCount local is used in the per-address limit comparison.
tokenId parameter selects the token whose owner is checked and which is named.
name parameter is validated then stored in _tokenNames and _namesUsed.
str parameter is the input validated by validateName.
str parameter is the input lowercased by toLower.
addressOneAmt local is computed as contract balance multiplied by 15/100.
addressTwoAmt local is computed as contract balance multiplied by 5/100.
mint calls isWhitelisted to gate non-owner callers.
setName calls validateName to validate the requested name.
setName calls isNameUsed to reject duplicate names.
setName calls toLower before writing to _namesUsed.
isNameUsed calls toLower on the supplied name.
onERC721Received returns control to mint during the minting loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _mintAmount only exists to drive the mint loop and payment multiplication.
Local supply is a transient snapshot of totalSupply() inside mint.
Local ownerMintedCount is a transient read of addressMintedBalance used only in mint.
Parameter tokenId is consumed only by setName for ownership and naming logic.
Parameter name is consumed only by setName for validation and storage.
Parameter str is the sole input of validateName.
Parameter str is the sole input of toLower.
Local addressOneAmt exists only to size the low-level payout in withdraw.
Local addressTwoAmt exists only to size the low-level payout in withdraw.
